AUC superiority test calculation

Source: R/auc_calculations.R
calculate_auc_superiority.Rd

AUC superiority test calculation

Usage

calculate_auc_superiority(
  auc,
  auc0,
  prevalence,
  alpha,
  power,
  ratio = NULL,
  var_method = "binormal"
)

Arguments

auc

Expected AUC value

auc0

Null hypothesis AUC value

prevalence

Disease prevalence (used only to derive the non-diseased:diseased sampling ratio R; omitted or 1 falls back to 1:1)

alpha

Type I error

power

Statistical power

ratio

Controls per case; alternative to prevalence.

var_method

AUC variance model (binormal by default).

Value

List with calculation results
